# Presets

Pre-packaged player configurations that bundle state management, skins, and media components for specific use cases.

A **preset** packages what you need for a specific player use case. It can include special [state management](./features.md), one or more [skins](./skins.md) for UI, and specific media components. Instead of assembling these pieces individually, you pick a preset that matches what you’re building.

For example, the `@videojs/html/background` preset includes a media component with autoplay, mute, and loop built in, a skin with no controls, and just the features needed to power them:

**index.html**

```html
<script type="module">
  import '@videojs/html/background/player';
  import '@videojs/html/background/video';
  import '@videojs/html/background/skin';
</script>

<background-video-player>
  <background-video-skin>
    <background-video src="hero.mp4"></background-video>
  </background-video-skin>
</background-video-player>
```

## Available presets

The default presets are `/video` and `/audio`. These cover the baseline controls you’d expect from the HTML `<video>` and `<audio>` tags. Beyond the defaults, presets target more specific use cases — the `/background` preset, for example, needs layout but not controls. Over time we’ll add more: short-form players, podcast players, TV streaming players, and others.

The video, audio, live video, and live audio presets also export Compat skins. For example, React exports `CompatVideoSkin` with `@videojs/react/video/compat-skin.css`; HTML registers `<video-compat-skin>` through `@videojs/html/video/compat-skin`.

| Import | Description | Details |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `@videojs/html/video` | General-purpose video player preset with full playback controls. | **Feature bundle:** `videoFeatures`; **Features:** [playback](../reference/api/feature-playback.md), [playbackRate](../reference/api/feature-playback-rate.md), [quality](../reference/api/feature-quality.md), [audioTrack](../reference/api/feature-audio-track.md), [volume](../reference/api/feature-volume.md), [time](../reference/api/feature-time.md), [source](../reference/api/feature-source.md), [buffer](../reference/api/feature-buffer.md), [fullscreen](../reference/api/feature-fullscreen.md), [pip](../reference/api/feature-pip.md), [remotePlayback](../reference/api/feature-remote-playback.md), [controls](../reference/api/feature-controls.md), [textTrack](../reference/api/feature-text-tracks.md), [error](../reference/api/feature-error.md), [metadata](../reference/api/feature-metadata.md); **Skins:** `<video-compat-skin>`, `<video-neutral-skin>`, `<video-scaffold-skin>`, `<video-skin>`; **Default media component:** `<video>` |
| `@videojs/html/audio` | Audio-only player preset with playback and volume controls. | **Feature bundle:** `audioFeatures`; **Features:** [playback](../reference/api/feature-playback.md), [playbackRate](../reference/api/feature-playback-rate.md), [volume](../reference/api/feature-volume.md), [time](../reference/api/feature-time.md), [source](../reference/api/feature-source.md), [buffer](../reference/api/feature-buffer.md), [error](../reference/api/feature-error.md), [metadata](../reference/api/feature-metadata.md); **Skins:** `<audio-compat-skin>`, `<audio-neutral-skin>`, `<audio-scaffold-skin>`, `<audio-skin>`; **Default media component:** `<audio>` |
| `@videojs/html/background` | Ambient background video preset with no user controls. | **Feature bundle:** `backgroundFeatures`; **Features:** –; **Skins:** `<background-video-skin>`; **Default media component:** `<background-video>` |
| `@videojs/html/live-audio` | Live audio player preset — `audio` minus playback rate, plus the live feature, with a skin that swaps the time slider and time displays for a Live button. | **Feature bundle:** `liveAudioFeatures`; **Features:** [playback](../reference/api/feature-playback.md), [volume](../reference/api/feature-volume.md), [time](../reference/api/feature-time.md), [source](../reference/api/feature-source.md), [buffer](../reference/api/feature-buffer.md), [error](../reference/api/feature-error.md), [live](../reference/api/feature-live.md), [metadata](../reference/api/feature-metadata.md); **Skins:** `<live-audio-compat-skin>`, `<live-audio-neutral-skin>`, `<live-audio-scaffold-skin>`, `<live-audio-skin>`; **Default media component:** `<audio>` |
| `@videojs/html/live-video` | Live video player preset — `video` minus playback rate, quality selection, and audio-track selection, plus the live feature, with a skin that swaps the time slider and time displays for a Live button. | **Feature bundle:** `liveVideoFeatures`; **Features:** [playback](../reference/api/feature-playback.md), [volume](../reference/api/feature-volume.md), [time](../reference/api/feature-time.md), [source](../reference/api/feature-source.md), [buffer](../reference/api/feature-buffer.md), [fullscreen](../reference/api/feature-fullscreen.md), [pip](../reference/api/feature-pip.md), [remotePlayback](../reference/api/feature-remote-playback.md), [controls](../reference/api/feature-controls.md), [textTrack](../reference/api/feature-text-tracks.md), [error](../reference/api/feature-error.md), [live](../reference/api/feature-live.md), [metadata](../reference/api/feature-metadata.md); **Skins:** `<live-video-compat-skin>`, `<live-video-neutral-skin>`, `<live-video-scaffold-skin>`, `<live-video-skin>`; **Default media component:** `<video>` |

## What’s in a preset

Each HTML preset provides registration entry points for a preconfigured player element, its skins, and any preset-specific media component, plus the feature bundle needed to compose your own player. For example, `@videojs/html/video/player` registers `<video-player>`, while `@videojs/html/video/skin` registers `<video-skin>`.

These parts aren’t equally tied together. Skins depend tightly on their feature bundle — a skin expects specific features to exist. Media components are more interchangeable — you can swap in an HLS or DASH provider without changing your skin or features.

HTML preset roots are side-effect-free modules for importing the configured classes, typed controller, and feature bundle:

```ts
import {
  PlayerController,
  VideoPlayerElement,
  VideoSkinElement,
  videoFeatures,
} from '@videojs/html/video';
```

Registration is explicit, so importing a value never changes the custom element registry. Registration entry points are side-effect-only; import classes, controllers, and types from the preset root:

```ts
import '@videojs/html/video/player'; // <video-player> only
import '@videojs/html/video/skin';   // <video-skin> + container + video UI
// Import '@videojs/html/video/neutral-skin' instead for the neutral skin.
```

A complete player imports `video/player` and one skin. Each skin registration includes its container and UI dependencies but does not register the player.

## Customizing a preset

You can customize a preset in three ways: extend its feature bundle, add its skin source to your project, or swap its media component.

### Extend the feature bundle

Add features to a preset’s feature bundle to enable new functionality. For example, adding playback controls to a background video:

**index.html**

```html
<script type="module">
  import { createPlayer, playbackFeature } from '@videojs/html';
  import { backgroundFeatures } from '@videojs/html/background';
  import '@videojs/html/background/video';
  import '@videojs/html/ui/container';
  import '@videojs/html/ui/play-button';

  const { PlayerElement: MyPlayer } = createPlayer({
    features: [...backgroundFeatures, playbackFeature],
  });

  customElements.define('my-player', MyPlayer);
</script>

<my-player>
  <media-container>
    <background-video src="hero.mp4"></background-video>
    <media-play-button>Play / Pause</media-play-button>
  </media-container>
</my-player>
```

### Skin source

If a preset’s skin is close but not quite right, [add its source to your project](./customize-skins.md#style-skin-source) and customize its components and styles.

### Swap the media component

A preset’s default media component is just the starting point. You can replace it with any compatible media provider. For example, using an HLS source with the video preset:

```html
<video-player>
  <video-skin>
    <hlsjs-video src="https://example.com/stream.m3u8"></hlsjs-video>
  </video-skin>
</video-player>
```
